order: Sixteenth patch after the documented downstream chain, including standalone helper compatibility.
implementation: Adds opt-in LIBRECAD_USE_SYSTEM_LIBDXFRW; OFF keeps bundled sources. ON requires the installed libdxfrw CONFIG package, removes bundled include/source entries and links its exported target publicly. The filter includes the installed handle header under intern/. System mode explicitly rejects BUILD_TESTS=ON because existing test targets require noninstalled codec internals.
validation: macOS ARM64: using the option, the full default application/helper build succeeded in the existing clean-source qualification build directory after reconfiguration from an earlier temporary overlay and a full rebuild of affected objects.

The application link command names the staged static archive 719521dae87b5da63ab9bc2fb68cd2cfe70172ba30027d1f35a40428fc6e5224; the LibreCAD archive has none of the checked bundled drw_entities, drw_objects, drw_base, libdxfrw, libdwgr or dwgbuffer object members.
The installed-mode application converts the workspace-local AC1021 lineweights sample; it safely refuses the independently diagnosed AC1024 title-block sample for the R2010 output profile.
The default bundled mode configures with BUILD_TESTS=ON; its focused LTYPE selector passes 17/17 and the five PR #3269 tests pass.
System mode with BUILD_TESTS=ON refuses with the explicit test-internals diagnostic; a required package disabled at configuration also refuses. Forward/reverse patch checks pass on the ordered chain.
limits: A fresh empty installed-mode build directory is being checked separately. Installed mode currently has no supported BUILD_TESTS=ON path, and shared-library, Linux/Windows, GUI and broad runtime qualification remain open. The patch is unmerged. No phase or format support claim is promoted.
